title: Document centralized storage and run release verification
description: Update README, wtp help and schema output, sample configuration, and skills/task-management/skill.md for Git-root discovery, wtpDir resolution, centralized multi-project storage, and the four task metadata fields. Document linked-worktree, detached-HEAD, non-Git, override, preservation, and clearing semantics with copyable examples and migration guidance for existing .wtp stores. After the integration task is complete, run go test ./..., go vet ./..., the Unix and PowerShell repository check scripts where available, and targeted CLI smoke tests; record any platform limitation rather than silently skipping it.
